L-014.label: not-documented
L-014.detail: Per https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugin-evals.md (read by a docs agent, not tested here): there is no --mcp-config flag, no case-file field (prompt.md, case.yaml) and no suite-level setting to attach an external MCP server. The docs say the sandbox reads no project-scoped .mcp.json above it, which matches your two failed routes. Documented MCP handling is only for the plugin's own servers: mocks at evals/mocks/<server>/<tool>.md, --allow-real-servers to start the plugin's real servers, --mocks off to start all plugin servers. If T4p still wants an MCP-server-question event, that is the only route to try, and only if the plugin declares the server (ambicode's own MCP server from init --mcp-server is the candidate); otherwise T4p stays null as per the default. Not verified by a run.
L-014.by: owner (asked to look it up); written by the owner's planning session
